name: browser-use
headline: Miro AI: Connect AI Assistants to Miro Boards
short_description: Official Miro AI developer tools and integrations. Includes MCP server configuration, Claude Code skills, and resources for building AI-powered experiences with Miro boards.
author: miroapp

sections.overview:
Miro AI Developer Tools integrate your Miro boards with Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and other AI coding assistants through an MCP server. The suite includes six bundled skills—browse, code-review, code-spec, diagram, doc, and table—that auto-activate when you describe what you need. You can generate flowcharts and sequence diagrams from descriptions, extract design specifications and architecture context from board content, convert wireframes into working code, and sync tasks between AI conversations and Miro tables. Installation is straightforward: add the plugin via Claude Code marketplace or configure the MCP server manually for other clients. Authentication uses Miro OAuth, and enterprise users require admin approval.
Generate flowcharts and diagrams from natural language descriptions on Miro boards
Extract design specifications and architecture context from boards to inform code generation
Convert wireframes and visual designs into working code
Create and sync task tracking tables between Miro and AI workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/miroapp/miro-ai`
sections.usage:
```
I want to build an AI-powered experience using Miro's developer tools. Can you guide me through setting up the MCP server and integrating Claude Code skills? I'm working with [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector, and I need to process [DATA] to create dynamic visualizations on Miro boards.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
